description.narrative: Insatsen innebär ett pilotprojekt vars syfte är att visa en modell på hur det nationella skolmatsprogrammet i Etiopien kan implementeras. Projektet ska bygga upp piloter i 7 skolor i en region (zone) samt bidra med kapacitetsutveckling till andra skolor och regioner så det kan genomföra något liknande på egen hand efter projektets slut.
The contribution aims at proving an example to the GoE of how the national school feeding prgramme may be implemented.

The objectives for the school feeding programme are as follows: 1. Implementation of nutritional guidelines 2. Support the structural system for effective execution and management of the school feeding programme 3. Strengthening technical capacity of the school feeding program implementers
Further, the objectives for the COVID-19 response are the following: 1. Ensure physical distancing in public areas to prevent the transmission of COVID-19 2. Improve behaviours around good hygiene and sanitation practices in communities to prevent the spread of COVID-19 3. Strengthening capacity of regional government to establish a model for COVID-19 prevention that can be scaled throughout Amhara region

- Exhibited increased level of awareness and understanding of the importance of school feeding program among various stakeholders at local, regional and national level including government high level decision makers, policy designers, institution leaders and the wider community.
- It was reported that the local government and the community in the project area have contributed around 9,7 MBirr in the form of cash and in kind contribution
- Taking the learnings of ESMI, Addis Ababa City Administration is now implementing full-fledged school feeding program.
- Ministry of Education has established responsible and accountable structure in implementing school feeding program. In addition Regional Education Bureaus assigned focal persons in implementing school feeding program.
- The national school feeding program policy and strategy has been endorsed following the result of advocacy made by ESMI. ESMIs workable models and good practices have been included in recently endorsed school feeding program policy and strategy.
- Developed and adapted a package of operational tools for implementing the school feeding program. The tools included: Standardized Guidelines and Manuals of school feeding program; Standards of Model School Kitchen Construction, Kitchen Management Training Manual, Social accountability manual
- Established five model school kitchens at Dehana- Amdework, Gazgibla- Asketma, Zequala- Tsitsika Sekota Zuria Hamusit, and Sekota town-Azeba primary schools.
- Established an efficiently managed Model Fortified Food Processing Factory Plant in Sekota town.
- Documented the impacts of the school feeding program across the project targeted schools to capture indirect results of the program which includes, increased Net Enrollment for pre-school, Reduced dropout, absenteeism and lateness rate significantly, Reduced students instant hunger at school, improved students desire to go to school.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
